title: Research Agent Architecture
topic: The architecture of this research agent: GitHub as the central source of truth, Anthropic-powered Claude Code agents in ephemeral sandboxes as the write path, Vercel as the runtime/presentation layer with a password auth gate, living reports, templated-repo patterns (graph DB + agentic parsing; project-management layer with source plugins like Azure DevOps), and the Vercel-to-Advisory-Digital-Gateway hosting evolution.
summary: Documents this system as an instance of a reusable pattern — GitHub as the single source of truth, Claude Code as the only write path, and a runtime layer (Vercel today) as the read path with a password gate — then generalizes it into templated repos and a Vercel-to-Digital-Gateway hosting path with a short-term quick win.
key_claims: GitHub is the single source of truth; the web library and memory index are derived from projects/<slug>/manifest.json, never hand-curated.
Claude Code, running in ephemeral Anthropic-powered sandboxes, is the only write path to the source of truth.
The runtime layer (Vercel today) is the read path: build-library.mjs renders the repo into a Next.js library on every push, with a single-password gate as the auth layer.
Living reports: a deterministic slug means re-running a topic revises the same project folder in place, bumping version and appending a changelog.
The pattern is templatable: swap the payload for a graph database with an agentic parsing layer, or a project-management layer with source connectors like Microsoft Azure DevOps.
Hosting evolves while the core stays put: Vercel today to the Advisory Digital Gateway on Azure tomorrow; the short-term quick win is shipping on Vercel behind a real APP_PASSWORD.
